summary.text: Dana Stein is a Democratic delegate representing District 11B in the Maryland House of Delegates, where he has served since 2007, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He co-founded the nonprofit Civic Works.

paragraphs.text: Dana Stein was born in Baltimore, Maryland.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 1981, a master's degree in public affairs from Princeton University in 1985, and a juris doctor from Columbia University in 1985.

His career experience includes co-founding Civic Works and serving as its president and executive director, serving as president of Grassroots Recycling, Inc., and working as an attorney with Squire, Sanders, & Dempsey.
He has served as vice president of the Sudbrook Park, Inc. board of directors, on the Maryland Certified Public Managers Advisory Board, and as treasurer of the Liberty Road Community Council.

Stein's 2025-2026 committee assignments include the Environment and Transportation Committee, the Legislative Policy Committee, the Legislative Ethics Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee, and he is House chair of the Chesapeake and Atlantic Coastal Bays Critical Area Committee.
In the 2026 general election he is running for one of two District 11B seats alongside fellow Democrat Jon Cardin and Republican John Gordon.
